messages.subject: Re: Create Login page using shiny
parts:
I've been working on this lately, too. A Google search on "shiny login" returns a whole lot of useful information. The link I found most helpful was 
https://gist.github.com/calligross/e779281b500eb93ee9e42e4d72448189

R and Shiny are typically used to statistically summarize data that has been collected elsewhere. There hasn't been nearly as much work done on using Shiny with a database to actually collect data, which is why examples and tools for things like login and saving to MySQL (as opposed to getting data out of MySQL) are currently so sparse.

Tom
